Brake System Specification

System Overview

The braking system shall provide safe and predictable deceleration under all supported operating conditions.

Warning

Emergency braking has highest priority and shall override all normal braking requests.

Functional Requirements

Brake System Requirements

ID

Requirement

Priority

BRK-001

Emergency braking shall be available above 5 km/h.

HIGH

BRK-002

Brake pressure shall be continuously monitored.

HIGH

BRK-003

Diagnostic information shall be stored after a failure.

MEDIUM

Important Information

Note

Changes to BRK-001 require a safety review.
